text:
Ryan Soto: Morning folks, first-day setup hiccup. Desk kit arrived but: 1) USB-C dock charges laptop but headset mic isn't detected, 2) monitor stand arrived without screws so can't mount, 3) corp-secure wifi (802.1X) keeps saying 'EAP authentication failed' after SSO. Which queue do I file and who can help quickly?

Aisha - IT: Welcome Ryan :wave: Sorry about the scramble. If you want I can open a ticket for you. Quick checks: which OS (macOS/Windows) and headset model? Also can you try connecting headset directly to laptop to confirm it's not the headset?

Ryan Soto: I'm on macOS Ventura company image. Headset is "ClearTalk Pro" USB-C. Plugged direct into laptop and mic works fine. When plugged into dock mic shows up as "USB Audio Device" but input level stays at 0 and apps (Zoom) don't see it.

Aisha - IT: Thanks. Two paths: driver/firmware for the dock or a permissions/keychain issue on mac. Try this quick debug and paste results: 1) In Terminal run `system_profiler SPAudioDataType` and paste the USB device block. 2) Check System Settings -> Privacy & Security -> Microphone and ensure Terminal/Zoom have access.

Ryan Soto: system_profiler output shows the device enumerated under USB Audio: "ClearTalk Pro, Manufacturer: ClearCom, Input Channels: 1". Microphone permission for Zoom is toggled on.

Aisha - IT: If device enumerates but input level is 0, sometimes the dock's internal hub doesn't route the mic analog pin correctly (vendor issue). Can you open Audio MIDI Setup and see if the device sample rate/format looks odd? Also try switching the laptop's audio input to the ClearTalk in Sound Settings and then unplug/replug the headset from the dock.

Ryan Soto: Audio MIDI shows ClearTalk Pro at 48kHz, 2ch. Switching input in Sound Settings briefly shows waveform then nothing. I replugged and Terminal logs show USB reconnect.

Aisha - IT: I'm creating ticket IT-350555 and adding you. We'll try a remote firmware driver push for the dock and ship a USB-A adapter (ClearTalk also has a USB-A dongle) as fallback. Carlos will ship missing VESA screws.

Carlos (Shipping): Roger. IT-350555: VESA screw kit (M4x10) + USB-A ClearTalk dongle requested. I queued overnight shipping. Tracking: https://ship.redwood.com/track/1ZABC1234567890. ETA tomorrow morning.

Mia (Facilities): I can swing by with a small parts bag (screws + 2mm allen) if you want them today. Desk location?

Ryan Soto: Desk is C-21. If you can drop today that'd be awesome, I have an all-hands at 2pm.

Mia (Facilities): Dropping at C-21 now, left on top of monitor box.

Aisha - IT: For the Wi-Fi: EAP auth failures on mac often caused by stale 802.1X profiles or old SSO certs in Keychain. Steps: 1) Keychain Access -> search corp-wifi/corp-8021x and delete related items. 2) System Settings -> Network -> Wi-Fi -> Advanced -> 802.1X -> remove any saved profiles for corp-secure. 3) Reboot and rejoin. If you're short on time I can provision a 30-minute VPN token. Need it for the all-hands?

Ryan Soto: Yes please a VPN token would be great. I can't risk missing the all-hands.

Aisha - IT: Sent a 30-minute VPN token via DM. Also pushed note to IT-350555 to schedule driver push at 18:00 PT if you're available. If not, we'll swap the dock.

net-bot: [IT-350555] Status: "VESA screws en route, USB-A dongle shipped, 30-min VPN token issued." Ticket owner: Aisha - IT.

Ryan Soto: VPN token worked, joined all-hands. Quick follow-up: after I unplugged/replug the dock while Zoom open, mic started working for ~2 minutes then went silent again. Any logs I should capture?

Aisha - IT: That intermittent pattern points to a flaky USB power negotiation on the dock. If you can reproduce, run Console.app and filter for USB/Audio around the moment it drops and paste any repeated errors. I've also flagged a firmware regression on DockModel-Prime in the ticket.

Ryan Soto: Will catch logs if it happens again and paste to IT-350555. Thanks team for quick help!

Carlos (Shipping): Follow-up: tracking updated, expected delivery tomorrow 09:30.

Mia (Facilities): Glad screws fit when you got them. Ping if you need a hand mounting.

Aisha - IT: We'll monitor IT-350555 and either push driver or swap dock depending on logs. Ryan, reply here once you paste Console logs or confirm stable. :thumbsup:
